provenance.description: Golden cases for the shopping-policy-answer-v1 prompt, written before the prompt. expectedBehavior: answer_with_citations (every claim cites this turn's evidence) or abstain (knowledge base does not cover it). References point to X42 kb-eval-v1 cases; the four judge-disagreement cases from the X42 manual inspection (kb-eval-v1-2026-10-23-r3) are included as reference.
